json.overall_experience: This reviewer, a Chief Accountant, found Basecamp extremely difficult to use for their task of preparing a deadlines calendar. Despite easily finding the Deadlines & Milestones section, they could not locate any functionality to add new deadlines. This made the product unusable for their primary objective, leading to significant frustration and a very negative overall experience within their first six months of use.
